title: FINDRISC (Finnish diabète risque score)
formula:
The FINDRISC is calculated by adding the selected points for each variable:

| Variable | Points | | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Age, years | <45 | 0 | |
| 45-54 | 2 | | |
| 55-64 | 3 | | |
| >64 | 4 | | |
| BMI, kg/m 2 | <25 | 0 | |
| 25-29.9 | 1 | | |
| ≥30 | 3 | | |
| Waist circumference | Men | <94 cm (37 in) | 0 |
| 94 to <102 cm (37 to <40 in) | 3 | | |
| ≥102 cm (≥40 in) | 4 | | |
| Women | <80 cm (31 in) | 0 | |
| 80 to <88 cm (31 to <35 in) | 3 | | |
| ≥88 cm (≥35 in) | 4 | | |
| Use of blood pressure medication | No | 0 | |
| Yes | 2 | | |
| History of high blood glucose | No | 0 | |
| Yes | 5 | | |
| Physical activity | ≥4 hr/week | 0 | |
| <4 hr/week | 2 | | |
| Daily consumption of vegetables, fruits, or berries | Yes | 0 | |
| No | 1 | | |
| Family history of diabetes | No | 0 | |
| Yes, 2nd degree relative | 3 | | |
| Yes, 1st degree relative | 5 | | |

how_to_use.why:
- Identifie les personnes à risque de développer un diabète de type 2, oriente d’éventuels dépistages en laboratoire (p. ex., hémoglobine A1c) et permet la mise en œuvre d’interventions préventives.
- Recommandé comme calculateur de risque validé par le Groupe d’étude canadien sur les soins de santé préventifs (CTFPHC).
how_to_use.when: Utilisé pour évaluer le risque de diabète de type 2 chez un patient lors des consultations de suivi médical de routine.

next_steps.advice: Cet outil peut être utilisé pour identifier les facteurs de risque modifiables (p. ex., alimentation, activité physique), qui peuvent être ciblés par l’éducation du patient et des modifications du mode de vie.
next_steps.management:
Suggested management based on the CTFPHC recommendations:

| Score | Recommendation |
| --- | --- |
| 0–14 points | Routine screening for type 2 diabetes is not recommended. |
| 15–20 points | Hemoglobin A1c screening every 3–5 years. |
| ≥21 points | Hemoglobin A1c screening annually. |

For additional guidance on type 2 diabetes screening, please refer to the[Canadian Task Force on Preventive Health Care guidelines](https://canadiantaskforce.ca/the-canadian-task-force-on-preventive-health-care-releases-updated-guideline-for-screening-adults-for-type-2-diabetes/).

more_info:
Interpretation:

| FINDRISC | Risk | 10-year risk of developing T2DM | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Men | Women | | |
| 0-3 | Very low | 0.3% | 0.1% |
| 4-8 | Low | 0.8% | 0.4% |
| 9-12 | Moderate | 2.6% | 2.2% |
| 13-20 | High | 23.1% | 14.1% |
| ≥ 21 | Very high | ~50%* | ~50%* |

*From[Lindström 2010](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmed/20513271).
medium_description: Identifies patients at élevé risque pour type 2 diabète.
